<div style="font-size:1.15em; margin-bottom:1em;">
'''openCR''' is a platform for compiling, publishing and consulting '''catalogues raisonnés''': complete, scholarly records of an artist's work. For every artwork, a catalogue raisonné documents its images, materials, measurements, inscriptions, ownership history, exhibitions and the literature that mentions it.
</div>

This wiki explains how openCR works. It is written for the people who build catalogues on openCR, the '''artist administrators''', and for the visitors who consult them.

<div style="border:1px solid #a2a9b1; background:#f8f9fa; color:#202122; padding:0.5em 1em; margin:1em 0;">The wiki is under construction. Pages marked as ''draft'' may still change.</div>
